load_bearing_primary_theorem.inspection_limits: The 82-page paper was not audited in full. The isoperimetric theorem is accepted as a standard geometric input, rather than reproved from foundations.
load_bearing_primary_theorem.area_distinction: The lemma uses spherical covering area. For the target class, injectivity identifies it with image-set area.
load_bearing_primary_theorem.applicable_classical_consequence: At normalized spherical derivative 1, image area is at least half of the sphere. The equality formula and the two complex normalizations leave only f(z)=z.
